tools.name: aw_health
tools.description: Liveness check for the Agent Watch API. Returns ok, service name, and version. Call this first to verify connectivity before using other tools.

tools.name: aw_check_endpoint
tools.description:
Probe an MCP or HTTP-402 endpoint now and get its trust verdict.

    Performs a real MCP initialize handshake (not a ping), measures p50/p95
    latency, counts tools, hashes the tool schema (for drift detection), and
    checks RFC 9728 auth metadata. Returns: alive (bool), name, tool_count,
    l

tools.name: aw_census
tools.description:
Full-census summary of the official MCP registry: 7,454 endpoints probed with real MCP handshakes.

    Returns alive/dead/unknown counts and percentages. States: alive = MCP
    initialize succeeded; dead = no answer; unknown = answered but auth-gated
    (401/403/402) or redirecting — liveness unp

tools.name: aw_list_monitored
tools.description:
List all endpoints in the Agent Watch census with their registry names.

    Returns count and the full endpoint list (URLs). Combine with aw_alerts
    to find which of these are dead. Read-only.

tools.name: aw_alerts
tools.description:
Show dead endpoints across the monitored registry (alive=false).

    Returns up to 500 dead endpoints with names. Use after aw_census or
    aw_list_monitored to get the actionable dead list. Read-only.

tools.name: aw_watch
tools.description:

    Plan-limited by the email used at checkout: free 5, Builder ($19/mo) 50,
    Team ($99/mo) 500 endpoints. Alerts fire on alive→dead transitions and
    tool-schema drift. Already-watched URLs are returned without re-p

tools.name: skills_list_tool
tools.description:
List this product's skills. Each entry carries the SKILL.md URI,
            its name and description, verbatim frontmatter, and a per-file
            sha256 manifest. Read a body with `read_skill`.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description:
Read a product skill file by its skill:// URI.

            Args:
                uri: e.g. skill://<product>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md
                     Get valid URIs from `skills_list_tool`.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "aw_health" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Liveness check for the Agent Watch API. Returns ok, service name, and version. Call this first to verify connectivity before using other tools.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "aw_census" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Full-census summary of the official MCP registry: 7,454 endpoints probed with real MCP handshakes. Returns alive/dead/unknown counts and percentages. States: al…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aw_check_endpoint, aw_list_monitored · Private data: aw_census, skills_list_tool, read_skill · Public sink: aw_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aw_check_endpoint, aw_list_monitored · Private data: aw_census, skills_list_tool, read_skill · Public sink: aw_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "aw_check_endpoint" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
